# nexus scrub

Verbs: start, stop

## Usage

```
nexus scrub [flags]
```

## Flags

```
  -h, --help   help for scrub
```

## Global flags

```
      --host string   target hosts: configured names, comma-separated, or all (default: NEXUS_HOST, then the default host)
      --verbose       log each request and response status to stderr
```

## Commands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`nexus scrub start`](nexus_scrub_start.md) | Start a scrub of a ZFS pool |
| [`nexus scrub stop`](nexus_scrub_stop.md) | Stop the scrub of a ZFS pool |
